# Purpose {#sec-purpose}

This notebook fits `grf::causal_forest()` on the extended analysis tibble from `10_data_prep_ext.qmd`, for both game outcomes.
Scope is **fitting and saving only**, as in `06_grf_fit.qmd`.
`prep_game()` and `fit_grf()` are copied verbatim from `06_grf_fit.qmd`.
Only the respondent-level moderator set changes: it adds the post-game correlates.

Two fits per game are saved:

- **Extended**: the paper's moderators plus the post-game correlates, on the extended sample. This is the fit the post-processing reads.
- **v1.0.0 covariates on the extended sample**: the paper's moderators only. The extended sample is smaller than the paper's and leans toward politically engaged respondents (`10_data_prep_ext.qmd`, `#sec-attrition`). Comparing this fit with the paper's separates the sample shift from the added covariates.

Post-game items are correlates, not moderators. Every result built on them is an exploratory addendum.

```{r}

#| include: false
# execution time

# console width
options(width = 80)
# packages
p_required <- c(
  "tidyverse", # dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr
  "here", # relative paths
  "fastDummies", # country fixed-effect dummies
  "grf", # causal_forest
  "sessioninfo" # session docs
)
packages <- rownames(installed.packages())
p_to_install <- p_required[!(p_required %in% packages)]
if (length(p_to_install) > 0) {
  install.packages(p_to_install)
}
sapply(p_required, require, character.only = TRUE)
rm(p_required, p_to_install, packages)
```

# Load data {#sec-load}

```{r}
#| label: load-data
dat <- readRDS(here::here("data", "02_processed", "eu25_long_ext.rds"))
var_dict_ext <- readRDS(here::here("data", "02_processed", "var_dict_ext.rds"))
```

# Variable definitions {#sec-vars}

`prof_mods` and `resp_mods` are the paper's frozen lists.
`resp_mods_ext` appends the post-game correlates, read from the variable dictionary.

```{r}
#| label: moderators
prof_mods <- c(
  "cj_nationality_shown",
  "der_cj_eu_identity",
  "der_cj_partisanship",
  "cj_age",
  "cj_sex",
  "cj_class"
)
resp_mods <- c(
  "q_gender",
  "q_age",
  "q_identity_country",
  "q_identity_eu",
  "q_identity_europe",
  "q_religion",
  "q_class",
  "q_eu_efficacy_understand",
  "q_pop_reps",
  "q_pop_goodevil",
  "q_pop_compromise",
  "q_dem_compromise",
  "q_dem_listen",
  "q_tech_experts",
  "q_tech_leaders",
  "q_party_harm",
  "q_people_incompetent",
  "q_eu_longterm",
  "q_eu_responsive",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_econ",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_cul",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_pol",
  "q_eu_abolish",
  "q_eu_satisfaction",
  "q_rural_urban",
  "q_edu_age_stop"
)
resp_mods_added <- var_dict_ext |>
  filter(!in_v1) |>
  pull(variable)
resp_mods_ext <- c(resp_mods, resp_mods_added)

stopifnot(
  # dictionary covers paper set
  all(resp_mods %in% var_dict_ext$variable),
  all(resp_mods_ext %in% names(dat))
)
resp_mods_added
```

`prep_game()` assembles the design for one game.
It takes the moderator set as an argument, so the same function builds both fits.

```{r}
#| label: prep-game
prep_game <- function(dat, game, mods) {
  sub <- dat |>
    filter(cj_game_type == game) # full per-game sample (no subsampling)

  y <- sub$cj_pl2
  z <- as.integer(sub$cj_rel == "muslim") # Muslim vs all-else pooled
  country_id <- factor(sub$meta_country)
  respondent_id <- factor(sub$meta_pid)

  mod_df <- sub |>
    select(all_of(mods)) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.character), factor))
  sub_X <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = mod_df) # factors -> dummies

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(sub_X),
    all(z %in% c(0L, 1L)),
    !anyNA(y),
    nrow(sub_X) == length(y)
  )

  list(
    y = y,
    z = z,
    sub_X = sub_X,
    country_id = country_id,
    respondent_id = respondent_id
  )
}
```

`fit_grf()` is unchanged from `06_grf_fit.qmd`: moderators plus country fixed-effect dummies in `X`, known conjoint propensity, respondent clusters, same seed.

```{r}
#| label: fit-grf
fit_grf <- function(d) {
  country_fe <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
    data.frame(country = d$country_id),
    remove_first_dummy = TRUE,
    remove_selected_columns = TRUE
  ) |>
    as.matrix()
  X <- cbind(d$sub_X, country_fe) # numeric moderators + country FE

  grf::causal_forest(
    X = X,
    Y = d$y,
    W = d$z,
    W.hat = 0.25, # known conjoint propensity
    clusters = as.integer(d$respondent_id), # respondent-level cluster-robustness
    num.trees = 2000,
    seed = 20260604
  )
}
```

# Extended fits {#sec-ext}

## Dictator game {#sec-ext-dictator}

```{r}
#| label: fit-dictator-ext
d_dict <- prep_game(dat, "cj_dict", c(prof_mods, resp_mods_ext))
cf_dict <- fit_grf(d_dict)
saveRDS(
  cf_dict,
  here::here("data", "03_final", "grf_dictator_ext.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)
cat(sprintf(
  "GRF dictator (extended) saved (n = %d, p = %d).\n",
  length(d_dict$y),
  ncol(cf_dict$X.orig)
))
```

## Trust game {#sec-ext-trust}

```{r}

d_trust <- prep_game(dat, "cj_trust", c(prof_mods, resp_mods_ext))
```
